title: When copying clips between tracks of different sample rates, clip's amplitude and loudness change
body:
1. Create a 48 kHz track with a **noise** clip on it
2. Create a 44.1 kHz track and generate **noise** on it
3. Copy the clip from the 48 kHz track
4. Paste it on the 44.1 kHz track
5. Observe: the loudness of the pasted clip is different from the source, both visually and audibly. "Measure RMS" result confirms it.
